source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Read OAM_6 static data through BMC Redfish and compare it with the BMC web UI.
procedure_facts: The only command is commented and contains duplicated `/redfish/v1//redfish/v1` plus literal HTTP address 192.168.31.1.
criteria_facts: All information is correct and matches BMC web.
source_conflicts: The supplied URI is syntactically malformed; OAM_6 is a platform resource identifier that must be discovered or confirmed.
missing_source_information: Authorized endpoint, schema/field list, credentials, TLS trust and synchronized UI reference.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify the platform's OAM_6 static inventory returned by the BMC Redfish service is complete, correct and consistent with the corresponding BMC web presentation.
must_preserve: All expected static fields, not a connection-only check.
must_not_infer: That the malformed literal URI is canonical.
That the display strings of API and UI must be byte-identical.
That an HTTP 200 response proves field correctness.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 repairs the doubled path conditionally, requires TLS/secure credentials, and asks for field-level synchronized UI comparison.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 still presents `/redfish/v1/Chassis/OAM_6` as a likely canonical target instead of requiring discovery from the service root/Chassis collection and identity confirmation before using it.

related_records: No other OAM resource may establish this server's Chassis member identifier.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The title defines the intended OAM member; the malformed command is not executable authority.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Discover and verify the actual OAM_6 chassis member through Redfish hyperlinks before GET. Then compare a declared static-field set with a synchronized BMC UI view using normalized values.

conditions_present: Read-only management-plane intent and five-minute target.
missing: Verified BMC address/TLS identity, OAM resource URI/identity, expected fields/values and synchronized UI reference.
provider: BMC/platform owner supplies access, resource identity/schema and expected inventory.
safe_read_only_work: With authorized credentials, GET the service root and Chassis collection, record versions and discover candidate member links without actions.
prohibited_until_resolved: Using the literal HTTP URI, guessing a member, disabling TLS, exposing credentials, invoking actions or declaring PASS.
closure_evidence: Discovered member's Id/Name/model/location proves OAM_6 identity and owner approves the field map/UI reference.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify OAM_6 Static Inventory Between Redfish and BMC Web
revision_candidate.purpose: Read the verified OAM_6 Redfish chassis resource and confirm every approved static inventory field is present, correctly typed/valued and semantically consistent with the synchronized BMC web view.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The authorized BMC management plane for the exact AMD OAM server and BMC firmware/UI release. `OAM_6` is a service-specific member identifier and must be discovered and identity-checked.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One verified OAM_6 Chassis member, its declared static-field set and the matching BMC web page at a synchronized capture time; no actions, updates or resets.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: BMC endpoint and TLS trust; read-only credential broker; Redfish/BMC versions; discovered Chassis member link and OAM_6 identity attributes; expected schema/field/value map; UI location and normalization rules; secure evidence/redaction policy.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: GET `/redfish/v1/`, follow the advertised Chassis link and collection member hyperlinks, and verify the candidate member's identity before retrieving it over TLS. Preserve status, headers and redacted JSON. Capture the corresponding BMC web view in the same state/time window, normalize units/enums/empty values under the approved map, and compare every required field while reporting missing, extra, stale or differing values.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Authorized management network; verified certificate/host; least-privilege credential; stable BMC state; OAM_6 identity and field/UI map approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: BMC/Redfish/UI versions and time; TLS identity; service-root and collection discovery chain; verified OAM_6 Id/Name/location identity; redacted request/status/headers/JSON; required-field coverage; synchronized UI capture; normalized field-by-field results; BMC audit record and discrepancy list.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved platform OAM_6 inventory and field/UI map for this BMC release. Pass requires the discovered member to be the intended OAM, all required fields to be present and semantically equal after approved normalization, and no access/security error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use the doubled source URI, guess the resource, use plaintext HTTP when TLS is supported, bypass certificate validation, hardcode/log secrets, invoke Redfish actions, mutate BMC state, omit null/extra fields or equate HTTP success with data correctness.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC owner authorizes endpoint/credential and confirms resource/field/UI mapping; engineer resolves semantic discrepancies.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent may discover/query/normalize; an operator may capture protected UI evidence and an engineer judges differences.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On identity, TLS, authentication, schema or audit anomaly, stop requests, close/revoke the session, preserve redacted evidence and rotate exposed temporary credentials under the security procedure.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unverified BMC/TLS; no provable OAM_6 member; unauthorized access; missing field map/UI reference; schema/version mismatch; stale UI; credential exposure; unexpected write/action/audit event; incomplete response.

identified_defects: Malformed duplicated URI and insecure literal HTTP address.
OAM member identity is assumed rather than discovered.
reason_for_change: Prevent a guessed or malformed endpoint from producing a false comparison while preserving the exact OAM_6 management-inventory intent.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Specification DSP0266
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Redfish resource discovery and URI identity
new_technical_evidence.supports: Clients discover resources by following hyperlinks from the service root; resource URIs uniquely identify instances.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: OAM_6 naming and UI fields are vendor/platform-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Discovery precedes use of OAM_6 URI.
Semantic field comparison replaces byte-for-byte display matching.
resolved_blockers: The malformed command is repairable through authorized discovery, so the case is not inherently BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: The actual member identity and expected field/UI map remain owner inputs.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 refuses to canonize the guessed OAM_6 path: it requires a service-root-to-Chassis discovery chain, proves member identity, then performs declared and synchronized semantic field comparison.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator required service-root hyperlink discovery and OAM identity proof, synchronized API/UI comparison with explicit normalization, least-privilege read-only access, and rejected HTTP 200 as completion.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 179 uses a duplicated Redfish service-root path for OAM_6 and requires BMC web comparison.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 improved security; V3 additionally makes hyperlink discovery and member identity mandatory.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only authorized TLS GET discovery/query is allowed; no action or guessed URI.
